onboarding.title: Farm configuration
onboarding.subtitle: Complete these steps to configure FleetWise for your operation.
onboarding.step1Desc: Register each tractor, bakkie, harvester and implement, or import the fleet from a spreadsheet.
onboarding.step3Desc: Print and fit a QR label to each machine. This enables any staff member to report a fault or record a meter reading from a phone without signing in.
onboarding.step3Hint: Print on plain paper and fit in a dry location — inside the cab door is recommended.

faults.emptyHint: Faults submitted from the QR page or from this screen are listed here.

offline.savedOffline: Saved locally. It will sync when a connection is available.

doc.leadPartner: All quotations and invoices issued, across every client account.
doc.leadFarm: Quotations and invoices received from your contractors.
doc.newSubjectHint: A short reference line the client will recognise.
doc.emptyPartnerBody: Create one against a client account, or attach a document produced in your own system.
doc.emptyFarmBody: Quotations and invoices from your contractors will appear here.
doc.sendExplains: Once issued, the wording and totals are fixed — the document becomes a formal record.
doc.sentFlash: Issued. The client can now view it.
doc.deleteDraftBody: The draft was never issued, so no record is lost. Its line items are removed with it.
doc.acceptBody: The contractor will be notified of your approval. No payment is due until they invoice.
doc.acceptedFlash: Approved. The contractor has been notified.
doc.declineReasonHint: The reason determines the contractor's next step — please be specific.
doc.uploadBody: Attach the quotation or invoice your accounting system produced. Your client can view it and it is reflected in their costs; your existing invoicing process is unchanged.
doc.upgradeBody: The Managed plan adds itemised quotations and invoices, quote-to-invoice conversion, and payment recording.
doc.upgradeKeep: Existing functionality is retained — attaching your own documents remains part of your plan.
doc.oneOffHint: No customer record is created. Enter the billing details on the document itself.
doc.billToVatHint: Required for the customer to claim input VAT.

partnerSettings.lead: These details appear on every quotation and invoice you issue.
partnerSettings.bankingHint: Printed on your invoices so clients can settle without contacting you.
partnerSettings.poweredByHint: Disable to show only your business name on documents.
partnerSettings.termsHint: Printed at the foot of every document.
partnerSettings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or SVG. Displayed at the head of every document.
partnerSettings.vatRegisteredHint: Disable if you are below the registration threshold. Documents will be issued without VAT.
partnerSettings.vatNotRegisteredNote: Documents are issued without VAT. The rate is retained should you register later.

pageInfo.documentsWhat: All quotations and invoices received from your contractors.
pageInfo.documentsNote: Approving a quotation does not initiate payment — the contractor must still invoice.
pageInfo.documentsPartnerWhat: All quotations and invoices issued, across every client account.
pageInfo.documentsPartnerNote: Attaching externally produced documents is available on all plans. Creating them here requires Managed.
pageInfo.partnerSettingsNote: Changes apply to new documents. Previously issued documents retain their original presentation.
pageInfo.clientsWhat: Your complete customer register — not only the accounts that found you on FleetWise.
pageInfo.clientsNote: Adding an account here grants no access to their data. Access follows only from an approved connection.

tour.contractorDocumentsBody: Create itemised quotations and invoices, convert an approved quotation to an invoice, and record payments as they are received. If you invoice elsewhere, attach that document instead — available on all plans.
tour.contractorBrandBody: Your business name, registration and VAT numbers, banking details, logo and colours. Every document is issued on your letterhead.

clients.lead: Your complete customer register — accounts already connected on FleetWise, and those that are not.
clients.addHint: Any customer you service. If they use FleetWise you can request a connection afterwards.
clients.notConnectedBody: This account is not connected to you on FleetWise, so their details are maintained here.
clients.askedBody: A connection request has been sent. Only the customer can accept it.
clients.syncConfirmBody: {n} vehicles will be added to {farm}'s fleet.
clients.syncConsequence: They become assets on the customer's fleet, visible to everyone at that account.
clients.vehiclesHint: Your own records of what they operate, maintained here until the account is connected.
clients.syncPartial: {n} copied. Some could not be added; the remainder are still pending — retry when ready.

partners.requestsHint: They have your account in their client register. Approving grants them access to your vehicles.
partners.approveConsequence1: They can view your vehicles, faults, job cards and service history.
partners.approveConsequence2: They can issue quotations and invoices, and update the work you assign them.

access.title: Access
access.baseline: Without any of these they can access the vehicles assigned to them, the faults and jobs on those vehicles, and the requests you issue. Nothing further.
access.costsHint: Pricing, budgets, fuel and job-card amounts, including amounts paid to other suppliers.
access.teamHint: Names, email addresses and telephone numbers of all farm personnel.
access.neverPartners: Your other suppliers are never disclosed to them, regardless of the settings above.
access.disconnectBody: {name} will lose access to this farm immediately.

correct.title: Corrections
correct.intro: Issued documents are immutable. Use a credit note to adjust an amount, or void the document if it should not have been issued.
correct.amountWrongHint: Issue a credit note and raise a replacement invoice. Both appear on the customer's account, as required.
correct.shouldNotExistHint: Wrong customer, or a duplicate. The document and its number are retained; the amount is reversed.
correct.voidBody: The amount is reversed. The document is retained with the reason recorded against it.
